preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == 1 or ('W' in S and S.count('W') == 1) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S contains exactly one 'W' (white cell) or is empty (only 'W'), and all lines after the first are valid test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) >= 1 and len(S) <= 10000 for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S has length between 1 and 10000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(S.count('W') == 1 for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S contains exactly one 'W' (white cell).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'Chef') == (not any((left := S[:S.index('W')]).count('B') > 0, (right := S[S.index('W')+1:]).count('B') > 0)) for i, S in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) if (left.count('B') + right.count('B')) % 2 == 0) and all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'Aleksa') == (any((left := S[:S.index('W')]).count('B') > 0, (right := S[S.index('W')+1:]).count('B') > 0)) for i, S in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) if (left.count('B') + right.count('B')) % 2 == 1)
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the total number of black cells on both sides of 'W' is even, output 'Chef' if no moves are possible (i.e., no black cells on either side), otherwise output 'Aleksa'. If the total number of black cells is odd, output 'Aleksa' if any move is possible, otherwise output 'Chef'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'Chef') == ((left := S[:S.index('W')]).count('B') == 0 and (right := S[S.index('W')+1:]).count('B') == 0) for i, S in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) if (left.count('B') + right.count('B')) % 2 == 0) and all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'Aleksa') == ((left := S[:S.index('W')]).count('B') > 0 or (right := S[S.index('W')+1:]).count('B') > 0) for i, S in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) if (left.count('B') + right.count('B')) % 2 == 1)
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the total number of black cells is even, output 'Chef' only if no black cells exist on either side of 'W'. Otherwise, output 'Aleksa'. If the total number of black cells is odd, output 'Aleksa' if any black cells exist on either side of 'W'.
